intro.line: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.
Dominaria is full of people who do not know what they are. The Coalition has to find them before they find out.

finale.line: Teferi's body couldn't travel through time far enough, but with Kaya's help, his spirit could.
Teferi learns the history Mishra never told anyone. The sleepers are exposed. Phyrexia is ready.
Recorded: the Brothers' War, retold from the inside.

villainFinale.line: Mishra was gone—all that remained was a machine wearing his face.
In this version, the praetor keeps her sleepers and Dominaria never learns who is who.

battles.title: Read Ahead
battles.blurb: Jodah and Teferi move on a village where half the neighbours do not know what they are.

scene.line: Phyrexians destroyed my village, but they cannot break my hope.
A single light can hold back endless darkness.
Read ahead: a saga lets you begin at any chapter. Pick the chapter you need and skip the rest.

villainScene.line: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.
With every culling, we bring this world closer to *compleation*.

hero.half: Begin the saga at the chapter you need.

battles.title: Urza and Mishra
battles.blurb: Teferi's spirit lands in the desert. Urza and Mishra are still brothers, but not for long.

scene.line: Raw energy contains infinite possibility.
As usual, my brother's maneuvers are brash and impulsive.
Domain: count the basic land types you control. Leyline Binding gets cheaper with every type, so mix your lands.

villainScene.line: While Urza read books, Mishra learned to read the desert itself.
Hah. Urza has underestimated my strength yet again.

hero.half: Count your land types, then bind.

battles.title: Small or Big
battles.blurb: Karn's archaeologists dig up a Phyrexian machine. Each one can be cast small or big.

scene.line: Remember, students, if it's glowing, humming, or whirring, don't touch it!
This metal junk is ugly, but it's got its uses.
Prototype: cast the machine for its small cost and get a small body now, or pay full price and get the big one.

villainScene.line: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.
In war, dragons don't see sides, just side dishes.

hero.half: Cast the small version when you are short of mana.

battles.title: Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor
battles.blurb: Teferi finally meets the Act 6 villain in the flesh. He counters what he can and watches what he cannot.

scene.line: Phyrexians pollute everything they touch, so the solution is simple: don't let them touch anything.
I've always made snap decisions. I'm just better at making the right ones now that I'm older and wiser.
Hold your mana on his turn. Counter the card that matters, and let the rest go.

villainScene.line: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.
Machines feel no fear, no sorrow, no hunger—only glorious purpose, true and pure.

hero.half: Counter the card that matters most.

battles.title: Ajani's Betrayal
battles.blurb: Ajani has been compleated, and his friends are the ones who have to stop him.

scene.line: Fear doesn't make you a coward; giving in to it does. Now take up your sword and fight!
Heroism is neither a strong arm nor a divine destiny. It is the choice to stand unbowed against impossible odds.
Enlist: tap a creature that is not attacking and add its power to an attacker. Let the weak ones help the strong.

villainScene.line: He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone.
Phyrexia may be ancient, but Gaea is eternal.

hero.half: Tap your small creatures to enlist.

battles.title: Mono-Red vs Esper Legends
battles.blurb: Autumn 2022: a cheap burn deck against Esper legends. Hit them before the legends show up.

scene.line: She focused her mind on the volcano's fury, and hers erupted in kind.
Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.
Race them. Their legends are slow and expensive. Burn them out before they stabilise.

villainScene.line: Karn's creation allowed him to monitor events across Dominaria—and everything he saw worried him.
All knowledge, past and future, is etched upon reality.

hero.half: Go face when they tap out.

battles.title: Rakdos vs Mono-Blue
battles.blurb: Autumn 2022: a Rakdos midrange pile against a mono-blue deck full of tricks.

scene.line: There can be no mercy, no half measures. When facing Phyrexians, it's kill swiftly or die.
There hasn't been an original thought on Vesuva in centuries.
Cast your cheap spells first. Make them spend their counters on the small things.

villainScene.line: Afterward, a number of treatises on sea serpent morphology were swiftly revised.
I adore your outfit. It's so . . . rustic.

hero.half: Bait with cheap spells, then land the big one.

battles.title: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
battles.blurb: The praetor who rules the sleepers. Every card you draw costs you life, and every card she draws costs you more.

scene.line: Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!
Root and wing, claw and sword; this will be a memorable stand, indeed.
Kill Sheoldred the turn she lands. Each turn she lives, you lose life and she gains it.

villainScene.line: Resist if you must. It makes no difference. As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia.

hero.half: Kill her at once or lose the race.

half.line: Not while we are still standing.

battles.title: The Brothers' War, Retold
battles.blurb: In the archive, Mishra's army plays at its original speed.

archive.what: A red-black deck of cheap burn and Mishra's artifact army, built around Mishra, Claimed by Gix.
archive.why: It had the most efficient burn in the format and a mana curve that few decks could match.
archive.beat: Block early and keep your life above burn range. Save a removal spell for the big Juggernaut.
archive.after: The Brothers' War ended in a sylex blast, and the format moved on.

deck.name: Mishra's Red-Black Artifacts
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: The peace summit proved the grudge between Urza and Mishra could end only in blood.
Block early and hold your removal for the Juggernaut.

villainScene.line: While Urza's machines favored defense, Mishra built his to end the war quickly.

after.line: Recorded: the Brothers' War ended in a sylex blast, and the format moved on.
